subject: QBR pipeline precision playbook — account matrix & OKR tieouts
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR pipeline precision playbook — account matrix & OKR tieouts

Team,

I’m kicking off a focused QBR prep thread: we need a clean, account-by-account matrix that ties pipeline position to our OKRs and surfaces forecast precision (best/likely/worst). I attached the working spreadsheet (QBR_account_matrix_v4.xlsx) — please use the tabs named by AE.

What I need from each account owner by end of day Monday (10/12):
- 150–200 word account summary (stage, primary use case, key contacts)
- Current forecast: best / likely / worst with rationale for movement since last update
- Top 3 risks and mitigations (pricing, technical, procurement)
- Which OKR(s) this account materially contributes to (OKR-IDs preferred)

Leadership will expect a consolidated slide with: net-new ARR at likely, pipeline conversion delta vs. last Q, and a short precision note about any accounts with >25% variance. I’ve put a column in the sheet to tag priority escalations.

I’ll be consolidating inputs and drafting the leadership summary on Tue morning. If anything is blocking you (data, slides, customer readiness), flag it here.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of GTM Strategy, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0149

Attachment: QBR_account_matrix_v4.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR pipeline precision playbook — account matrix & OKR tieouts

Neha — good plan. I’ll own the consolidation for the East accounts and will update the sheet for the following: Acme Cloud, NorthStar Analytics, BlueCloud.

I’m attaching a short note with the forecast-consolidation approach I used last quarter (forecast_consolidation_notes.pdf). Key asks from the field to make this tight: accurate close dates (not just quarter), confirmation of exec sponsor, and procurement windows.

Quick cadence:
- We’ll ingest AE inputs by EOD Mon (10/12)
- Triage outliers Tue morning (10/13) with Marcus and Aditya
- Final leadership slide Tue by 11:00 PT

If owners want the one-pager template, I’ll paste it below in a follow-up.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
SVP, Sales Operations
tessa_morgan@redwood.ai

Attachment: forecast_consolidation_notes.pdf (PDF)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 15:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR pipeline precision playbook — account matrix & OKR tieouts

Looping in a quick ops ask from leadership — they want a small "precision" box on the slide: win-rate by vertical and by stage for the accounts we’re pulling into likely. Marcus, can you run win-rate vs. last 3 quarters for: AdTech, FinServ, and Infra by EOD Mon? That will help justify any therapy (price/term) asks.

Also, we should pre-tag any account with >30% movement as "priority escalation" so CS and Solutions can be prepped for calls. I’ll work with Karthik on OKR mapping.

Aditya Rao
VP Sales, Americas
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR pipeline precision playbook — account matrix & OKR tieouts

Thanks — running the vertical win-rate now, attaching a quick one-pager for Acme while I pull the broader numbers. Below are the short account snippets I have for the ones I own (will paste into the sheet in a few):

Acme Cloud
- Stage: Contracting
- Likely: $820k; Best: $980k; Worst: $550k (timing + procurement hold)
- Risk: Procurement timeline shifted to Nov (legal review). Mitigation: offer a phased POC contract + DSC to unblock procurement; prepping a pricing letter.
- OKR tieout: OKR-3 (Expand infra revenue)

BlueCloud (partial)
- Stage: Negotiation
- Likely: $210k; Best: $260k; Worst: $0 (contingent on competitor proof-of-concept)
- Risk: competitive technical eval; mitigation: offer accelerated 2-week POC + technical workshop with Solutions.
- OKR tieout: OKR-1 (Increase platform adoption)

I’ll upload Acme one-pager as Acme_account_onepager.docx and populate the matrix. Expect the win-rate export to appear shortly in the shared drive.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Enterprise Sales
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachment: Acme_account_onepager.docx (docx)

From: Soma Patel <soma@acmecloud.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 17:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR pipeline precision playbook — account matrix & OKR tieouts

Hi Neha / Tessa — thanks for the clear asks and template. Procurement is reviewing the draft T&Cs; we’ll share a redline by Wednesday. Marcus — appreciated the one-pager, that aligns with what Legal expects.

Request: can we do a 20-minute alignment call Tue 10/13 at 11:00 PT to confirm procurement windows and any dependencies? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and include our head of procurement (copied).

Best,
Soma Patel
Head of Platform Strategy, Acme Cloud
soma@acmecloud.com
